QUOTE: `stop()` sets `running_` false, notifies the CV, and joins (`:102-111`).
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer describes the flag, CV notify, and join, but never says the flag is flipped by an atomic exchange. It only says "sets `running_` false", and it separately says flags are `std::atomic`. The item needs the exchange mechanism, so this is not stated.
